text: Behold, my servant,{H5650} whom I uphold;{H8551} my chosen,{H972} in whom my soul{H5315} delighteth:{H7521} I have put{H5414} my Spirit{H7307} upon him; he will bring forth{H3318} justice{H4941} to the Gentiles.{H1471}
He will not cry,{H6817} nor lift up{H5375} his voice,{H6963} nor cause it to be heard{H8085} in the street.{H2351}
A bruised{H7533} reed{H7070} will he not break,{H7665} and a dimly{H3544} burning wick{H6594} will he not quench:{H3518} he will bring forth{H3318} justice{H4941} in truth.{H571}
He will not fail{H3543} nor be discouraged,{H7533} till he have set{H7760} justice{H4941} in the earth;{H776} and the isles{H339} shall wait{H3176} for his law.{H8451}

Thus saith{H559} God{H410} Jehovah,{H3068} he that created{H1254} the heavens,{H8064} and stretched them forth;{H5186} he that spread abroad{H7554} the earth{H776} and that which cometh out{H7554} of it; he that giveth{H5414} breath{H5397} unto the people{H5971} upon it, and spirit{H7307} to them that walk{H1980} therein:

I, Jehovah,{H3068} have called{H7121} thee in righteousness,{H6664} and will hold{H2388} thy hand,{H3027} and will keep{H5341} thee, and give{H5414} thee for a covenant{H1285} of the people,{H5971} for a light{H216} of the Gentiles;{H1471}
to open{H6491} the blind{H5787} eyes,{H5869} to bring out{H3318} the prisoners{H616} from the dungeon,{H4525} and them that sit{H3427} in darkness{H2822} out of the {H3608} prison-house.{H1004}
I am Jehovah,{H3068} that is my name;{H8034} and my glory{H3519} will I not give{H5414} to another,{H312} neither my praise{H8416} unto graven images.{H6456}
Behold, the former things{H7223} are come to pass,{H935} and new things{H2319} do I declare;{H5046} before they spring forth{H6779} I tell{H8085} you of them.

Sing{H7891} unto Jehovah{H3068} a new{H2319} song,{H7892} and his praise{H8416} from the end{H7097} of the earth;{H776} ye that go down{H3381} to the sea,{H3220} and all that is therein,{H4393} the isles,{H339} and the inhabitants{H3427} thereof.

Let the wilderness{H4057} and the cities{H5892} thereof lift up{H5375} [their voice], the villages{H2691} that Kedar{H6938} doth inhabit;{H3427} let the inhabitants{H3427} of Sela{H5553} sing,{H7442} let them shout{H6681} from the top{H7218} of the mountains.{H2022}
Let them give{H7760} glory{H3519} unto Jehovah,{H3068} and declare{H5046} his praise{H8416} in the islands.{H339}

Jehovah{H3068} will go forth{H3318} as a mighty man;{H1368} he will stir up{H5782} [his] zeal{H7068} like a man{H376} of war:{H4421} he will cry,{H7321} yea, he will shout aloud;{H6873} he will do mightily{H1396} against his enemies.{H341}

I have long time{H5769} holden my peace;{H2814} I have been still,{H2790} and refrained{H662} myself: [now] will I cry{H6463} out like a travailing woman;{H3205} I will gasp{H5395} and pant{H7602} together.{H3162}
I will lay waste{H2717} mountains{H2022} and hills,{H1389} and dry up{H3001} all their herbs;{H6212} and I will make{H7760} the rivers{H5104} islands,{H339} and will dry up{H3001} the pools.{H98}

And I will bring{H3212} the blind{H5787} by a way{H1870} that they know{H3045} not; in paths{H5410} that they know{H3045} not will I lead{H1869} them; I will make{H7760} darkness{H4285} light{H216} before{H6440} them, and crooked places{H4625} straight.{H4334} These things{H4625} will I do,{H6213} and I will not forsake{H5800} them.
They shall be turned{H5472} back,{H268} they shall be utterly{H1322} put to shame,{H954} that trust{H982} in graven images,{H6459} that say{H559} unto molten images,{H4541} Ye are our gods.{H430}
Hear,{H8085} ye deaf;{H2795} and look,{H5027} ye blind,{H5787} that ye may see.{H7200}

Who is blind,{H5787} but my servant?{H5650} or deaf,{H2795} as my messenger{H4397} that I send?{H7971} who is blind{H5787} as he that is at peace{H7999} [with me], and blind{H5787} as Jehovah's{H3068} servant?{H5650}
Thou seest{H7200} many things,{H7227} but thou observest{H8104} not; his ears{H241} are open,{H6491} but he heareth{H8085} not.
It pleased{H2654} Jehovah,{H3068} for his righteousness'{H6664} sake, to magnify{H1431} the law,{H8451} and make it honorable.{H142}

But this is a people{H5971} robbed{H962} and plundered;{H8154} they are all of them snared{H6351} in holes,{H2352} and they are hid{H2244} in prison -{H3608} houses:{H1004} they are for a prey,{H957} and none delivereth;{H5337} for a spoil,{H4933} and none saith,{H559} Restore.{H7725}
Who is there among you that will give ear{H238} to this? that will hearken{H7181} and hear{H8085} for the time to come?{H268}

Who gave{H5414} Jacob{H3290} for a spoil,{H4933} and Israel{H3478} to the robbers?{H962} did not Jehovah?{H3068} he against whom{H2098} we have sinned,{H2398} and in whose ways{H1870} they would{H14} not walk,{H1980} neither were they obedient{H8085} unto his law.{H8451}

Therefore he poured{H8210} upon him the fierceness{H2534} of his anger,{H639} and the strength{H5807} of battle;{H4421} and it set him on fire{H3857} round about,{H5439} yet he knew{H3045} not; and it burned{H1197} him, yet he laid{H7760} it not to heart.{H3820}
